description: This script manages prebuilt tools for OpenWRT build environment, including functions to refresh timestamps, extract tar files, and install tools, with command-line options for directory paths and operations.

methods.name: refresh_timestamps
methods.description: Updates timestamps of files in a directory, excluding symbolic links.

methods.name: refresh_prebuilt_tools
methods.description: Refreshes timestamps of build and staging directories, ensuring they exist.

methods.name: install_prebuilt_tools
methods.description: Extracts tools from tar and refreshes their timestamps.
